stem.en: The graph shows the velocity of an object of mass 10 kg moving along a straight line. Use the graph to find the force acting on the object, in newtons.

explanation.en: From the graph, the velocity rises from 10 m/s at 0 s to 30 m/s at 8 s. a = (30 m/s - 10 m/s) / 8 s = 2.5 m/s². F = ma = 10 kg x 2.5 m/s² = 25 N.

hints.en: At 0 s the velocity is 10 m/s; at 8 s it is 30 m/s. Find a, then use F = ma.
